title: PlaylistsConfiguration
description: Configuration schema for L'Impressionnisme Vivant multi-playlist architecture.

app.description: Global application branding and presentation settings.

title.description: Main application title displayed in header and document title.

subtitle.description: Hero subtitle describing the gallery scope.

contactEmail.description: Curator and DMCA contact email address.

defaultResolutionFilter.description: Default quality filter selection on initial page load.

allowMultiPlaylistSelection.description: Whether to render playlist switcher pills when multiple playlists are active.

playlists.description: List of curated source YouTube playlists.

title.description: Display title for this curated playlist.

curator.description: Name of the curator responsible for this playlist.

enabled.description: Flag to enable or disable ingestion and gallery display.

description.description: Curatorial synopsis explaining the scope and motif of the collection.

prohibitedDownloadChannels.description: List of YouTube channel names requesting copyright download restrictions (view-only).
